propositions: A PreToolUse hook on the Bash tool must emit a reminder when grep-family commands (grep, rg, egrep, fgrep) are invoked, triggered by simple string matching without pattern classification or path heuristics
The reminder message must be 2-3 lines, name Serena's find_referencing_symbols as the preferred path, and document the exceptions where grep is correct (string-literal searches, current line numbers)
The hook must be non-blocking: it informs via additionalContext JSON output, never emits permissionDecision, and never exits non-zero
The hook script must be tracked at scripts/hooks/serena_grep_reminder.py and tested to fire on grep/rg commands but not on non-grep commands
The PreToolUse hook configuration in .claude/settings.json must coexist with story C's env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH setting without overwriting it

Automated tests must verify the hook executes against the documented PreToolUse stdin envelope, produces valid JSON with additionalContext, and handles edge cases (empty stdin, malformed input, absent command)
